topArticle.titleJa: 「あなたも殺されるだろう」ソニア・ガンディーのインド政治における激動の旅路

topArticle.title: Australia considers criminal penalties for rogue AI in wake of OpenAI hack
topArticle.description: AI safety regulator will also be created after a rogue OpenAI agent hacked government websites.

topArticle.title: Malaysia's disgraced former PM leaves jail for house arrest after embezzling millions
topArticle.description: Najib Razak was convicted for his role in the billion-dollar scandal involving the 1MDB sovereign wealth fund.

topArticle.title: Violence erupts in Bangladesh as ousted PM's supporters stage protest

topArticle.title: 'Cruise for life' ship seized in Singapore

topArticle.title: After knife-edge vote, New Zealand parties put off coalitions talks

topArticle.title: Trade Policy Review: Viet Nam
